title: The spies, unbelief, and God’s threat
english: On what the scouts report and on the Lord’s indignation: the people, panic-struck by unbelief, rush to stone those who bring good news, while the Lord’s majesty covers them. The Lord says, [[I will strike them with pestilence and make of you a greater nation >> Bible:Numbers 14:12]]. The threat is written not to show God passible, but that Moses’ love and God’s goodness may be known.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC (Numbers).
After Homilia VII tip ced8c601; Homilia VIII OCR title as VIE; CLOSEOUT.

title: Moses’ intercession and God’s goodness
english: Moses intercedes for the people. Scripture says God is angry and threatens ruin so that we learn how much place the prayer of the just has with God. If Moses could do so much, how much more may we trust that [[Jesus our advocate >> Bible:1 John 2:1]] will win sure pardon from the Father — if we turn and our heart does not draw back.

title: Christ our advocate
english: As John writes: [[I write this that you may not sin; and if anyone does sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous, who intercedes for our sins >> Bible:1 John 2:1-2]]. To him be glory forever. Amen.
